home.name: I'm Rachmad Aziz Fazarikha
home.address: Based in Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia
home.description: A Full-stack Web Developer and graduate (S.Kom.) in Information Systems from Universitas Trunojoyo Madura (GPA 3.74). Currently an AI Engineer intern at CV. Pakde Kingdom (PAK D Group) and a freelance Full-stack Web Developer.
home.description2: My focus is on creating dynamic, reliable, and scalable web applications by transforming complex problems into efficient digital solutions. Using modern technologies and frameworks, I am dedicated to building high-performance applications that combine elegant design with robust functionality. My primary goal is to bring a user-centered digital vision to life, ensuring seamless integration, ease of maintenance, and delivering tangible impact in the industry.

about.description: Hello! I am Rachmad Aziz Fazarikha, a Full-stack Web Developer and Information Systems graduate (S.Kom.) from Universitas Trunojoyo Madura (GPA 3.74). I build dynamic, efficient, and user-centric web applications, and I am now also growing in AI engineering as an intern at CV. Pakde Kingdom (PAK D Group) in Surabaya.
about.description2: I am highly motivated by the challenge of turning complex problems into streamlined digital solutions. By leveraging modern frameworks, I continuously seek to enhance my projects and am always eager to implement my knowledge into impactful, real-world applications that make a difference.
